description.text: Why SUT? 1. Situated in Shenyang—— a key modern city in the northeast; 2. Engineering oriented comprehensive university; 3. Pure English taught programs; 4. Specifically international students' accommodation with complete facilities; 5. Good climate with distinctively four seasons; 6. Convenient shopping environment. MainCourses Theoretical Mechanics, mechanics of materials, Structural mechanics, Civil engineering drawing and CAD, Civil Engineering Materials, Concrete structure design basic principle, Design Principles of Steel Structure, Civil Engineering Construction, Soil Mechanics & Substructure, Civil Engineering Surveying, earthquake resistance of engineering structure, Building construction, Bridge construction Multi-media classroom Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Students who are eligible to obtain a bachelor's degree and undergraduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by Major Cultivation Program and pass the undergraduate dissertation. Education System Four years International students' intership

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Shenyang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
